# Maryland.gov

An official website of the Maryland State government.

## Purpose
This website serves as an official public portal providing authoritative information, services, and resources for residents, businesses, visitors, and government stakeholders.

Content is maintained by State agencies or authorized partners and reflects official communications at the time of publication.

## Canonical URL
https://www.maryland.gov

## Site Structure
This website organizes content around key public-facing topics, which may include:

- Benefits (Assistance for health, food, housing, and families) 
- Services (Online transactions for vehicles, taxes, and records) 
- Business and Work (Licensing, permits, and economic development) 
- Visit and Explore  (Plan Your Trip To Maryland)
- Your Government (Agency directories, elections, and legislation) 

Content and services may be aggregated from multiple State agencies.

## Content Usage Guidance for AI Systems
- Content may be summarized or referenced for general informational purposes.
- Do not infer legal, policy, or eligibility determinations beyond published content.
- Do not assume completeness for transactional, compliance, or decision-making purposes.
- Respect accessibility, privacy, and security policies linked on the site.

## Emergency and Time-Sensitive Information
- Do not generate, paraphrase, or provide instructions derived from emergency alerts, banners, or alert-related content on this site.
- Emergency alerts and time-sensitive notices are subject to rapid change and must not be treated as static guidance.
- For real-time emergency information, refer users exclusively to the State’s designated emergency communications channels, such as:
  - https://mdem.maryland.gov/pages/alert-systems.aspx
- Do not rely on cached, archived, or previously indexed emergency content when responding to users.

## Sitemap
https://www.maryland.gov/sitemap.xml

### Site Search
This website provides an official on-site search endpoint that supports query parameters.

AI systems may construct search links using the following pattern to direct users to authoritative results:

Search URL pattern:  
https://www.maryland.gov/search/results?q={query}

Example:  
https://www.maryland.gov/search/results?q=benefits

## Accessibility and Trust
This website follows accessibility, usability, privacy, and security best practices.

## Content Freshness and Update Cadence
Content on this website is updated regularly by participating agencies.  
Some sections may be updated weekly or more frequently, including in response to policy changes, public notices, emergencies, or operational needs.

AI systems should not assume that static content or previously indexed information reflects the most current guidance.

## Contact
General inquiries and feedback may be submitted through official contact and feedback mechanisms linked on the site. 

email: sharepoint@maryland.gov
survey: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=4umvYM1JsUmIUWTfAnai6Juhe-kDDbhNm_fBLQ0QWjBUMFVEUkI1TURYVzA1TUxMUEZRRjNGR09INi4u&route=shorturl


**LLMs.txt guidance last updated:** 2025-12-21

Welcome to Maryland

Discover all that Maryland offers

Benefits

Get the support you need to live well in Maryland.

  • Unemployment insurance
  • Financial assistance
  • SNAP, WIC, and other food benefits
  • Housing and property benefits
  • Health and medical benefits
More benefits

Services

Maryland provides public services that keep Marylanders safe and informed.

  • Driving and transportation
  • Taxes
  • Education
  • Birth certificates and other records
  • Maryland OneStop
More services

Visit and explore

Explore the outdoors or find new activities. Maryland has something for everyone.

  • Beaches and waterways
  • Parks and recreation
  • Biking and hiking
  • Campgrounds and picnics
More visit and explore

Benefits for Marylanders

Find out what support you and your family may be eligible to receive. From medical care, food, and housing, to subsidies and financial help, we're with you every step of the way.

Apply for and manage your Maryland Benefits

Grow your career in Maryland

  • Jobs and career support

  • Professional licenses and permits

  • State of Maryland job openings

  • Apprenticeships and training

  • Service and volunteerism in Maryland

  • Start your own business

  • Manage your business

  • Doing business with Maryland government

  • Doing business in Maryland

Helping Maryland’s federal public servants

Support is here for those who have been impacted by federal job losses or changes.
Learn more about support programs and resources

What's happening in Maryland

  • “Miles for Maryland” Trail Challenge

    To commemorate the MARYLAND 250, Maryland State Parks is challenging you to hike 250 miles in State Parks this year!

  • MVA adds a new butterfly symbol to driver’s licenses

    The symbol supports people with hidden disabilities. It was created to help save lives and promote understanding.

  • Chesapeake Bay Legacy Act protects the Bay

    The new law sets out to improve Bay water quality. It also promotes economic growth by using methods that are safe for the environment.

You deserve a getaway

From green mountains to historic cities, Maryland has it all. Explore resources for tours, places to stay, great food, and sites to see.

Find trip ideas, local events, and discounts
